implementation: Owner run pins have a separate optimistic revision, database monotonicity guard and same-transaction audit. CAS/rollback and cross-Agent references tested.
Workbench exposes pin/unpin for the most recent run, including after completion. Generation/target/revision guards prevent stale polling responses overwriting a newer preference.

One repository eligibility query protects recent/nonterminal/pinned runs, unresolved actions/effects, model costs, work, held leases, outbound work including unknown, memory source anchors, document read contexts and pinned artifacts.

Bounded preview uses full UUID cursors, max50 ended runs at least30d old. Fingerprints stream canonical length-delimited run/action/event records without returning chat, tool arguments, result bodies or event payloads.

Offline retention-preview takes the same exclusive instance lock, shares the central read-only query lifecycle with diagnostics, refuses live or mismatched-schema instances and never upgrades/starts a runtime.
Preview is deliberately not an executable deletion plan: can_apply=false. No body pruning, context erasure, object reference release, audit deletion or TTL reuse of user-forget logic.

Fixed source-document index/delete race: editor stays disabled until rebuild and refresh finish; a controlled event-held browser regression covers it. Isolated service registration test signals publish atomically after JSON close.
Own workbench assets v17; four viewport widths and both themes include run pin/unpin regression. V2 default entrypoints unchanged.

development_failures.reason: Second full passed the document fix and exposed a preexisting test signal publication race: ready exists before its JSON is written. Made the isolated child fixture publish via closed temporary file + os.replace; no timeout or assertion relaxed.

Full run exposed source-document delete racing unfinished index rebuild/refresh. Disabled editor until rebuild and reload finish, added event-held regression, retained original assertion/timeouts; final full rerun required.
New CLI test expected instance_running; exact existing refusal code is instance_busy. Corrected assertion to parsed error, retaining refusal requirement.

New fixture closed the delivery service before inspecting, cancelling its pending proposal. Created the isolated proposal in its transaction without starting/closing a transport so pending protection is actually exercised.

pending: R3.retention_apply: verified backup, reviewed immutable plan, fingerprint and eligibility recheck, explicit body-pruned marks, bounded transactions, interruption/resume and restore.
Object reference release only after source/usage protection and via existing GC;180d summary/audit retention still needs reference protection and persistent cursor watermarks.
R5 native file bounds/identity and capability reports, terminal/desktop/system service adapters; R6 provider credentials/SDK clients, actual channels/vectors/business parity.
Three-platform actual deployment/native/account/model/device/load/fault and72h acceptance; default V1 remains.
